A: A short but powerful letter. The A transit marks a fresh start in your life — something begins, a new direction opens. It's a period of self-assertion and initiative. Even though this transit is brief, it can mark an important turning point. Secret vibration: beginning.
B: The B transit places relationships and sensitivity at the heart of this period. You are especially receptive to others and their emotions. It's a period favorable to alliances, partnerships and deepening existing bonds. Secret vibration: connection.
C: The C transit is a creative, communicative period. Your capacity for expression is amplified — ideal for any artistic, literary or communication-related project. Joy and enriching encounters characterize this period. Secret vibration: expression.
D: The D transit is a period of serious, methodical construction. You are building something lasting — a career, a relationship, a skill. It's a demanding but deeply productive period. Secret vibration: foundation.
E: The E transit is a period of major changes and rediscovered freedom. Important transformations occur, sometimes unexpectedly. It's a period of rapid growth through experience. Secret vibration: transformation.
F: The F transit places love, family and responsibilities at the center of your life during this period. It's often a period of major commitments — marriage, family, home. Beauty and harmony are recurring themes. Secret vibration: love.
G: The G transit is a deep, introspective period. You seek meaning, ask yourself big questions and connect to your spiritual dimension. It's often a period of great inner maturation, even if it can feel solitary. Secret vibration: wisdom.
H: The H transit is a period of power and achievement. Opportunities for material and professional success arise. It's also a period of transmutation — what ends opens the way to something greater. Secret vibration: power.
I: The I transit is one of the longest and deepest. It's a period of universal wisdom, service and major spiritual evolution. Important endings occur, but they prepare a major renewal. Secret vibration: fulfillment.
J: Like A, the J transit marks a fast, decisive fresh start. It's a period of initiative and self-assertion. Brief but significant — something new sets in motion. Secret vibration: initiative.
K: The K transit amplifies sensitivity and intuition. It's a period when your subtle perceptions are especially developed. Deep relationships and sincere collaborations are favored. Secret vibration: intuition.
L: The L transit is joyful and creative. It's a lovely period for expression in all its forms — writing, art, communication. Lightness and enriching encounters are on the agenda. Secret vibration: joy.
M: The M transit is a period of patient work and solid construction. You build with method and seriousness. It's a less spectacular-looking period, but deeply productive in practice. Secret vibration: perseverance.
N: The N transit brings movement, change and freedom. It's a period of accelerated transformation — some doors close, others open. Stay flexible and trust life's momentum. Secret vibration: renewal.
O: The O transit is a period of love and deep responsibilities. Love, family and matters of the heart are at the center of this long period. It's often one of the emotionally richest periods of your life. You give a lot — make sure to receive too. Secret vibration: devotion.
P: The P transit is a long period of inner maturation and spiritual quest. You seek truth, deepening your self-knowledge. This period can feel solitary but forges lasting wisdom. Secret vibration: depth.
Q: The Q transit is a long period of power and achievement. The important accomplishments of your life often take root in this transit. It's also an intense karmic period — act with integrity. Secret vibration: achievement.
R: The R transit is a long period of wisdom and service. You give a lot to others and touch deep truths about the meaning of your life. Important endings prepare a major renewal. Secret vibration: compassion.
S: The S transit is short and dynamic. It's a period of quick initiative — something begins, a decision is required. Act fast and with confidence. Secret vibration: momentum.
T: The T transit places patience and gentleness at the heart of this period. It's a period of relational building and inner refinement. Don't force it — let things fall into place naturally. Secret vibration: patience.
U: The U transit is creative and expressive. It's a lovely period for everything related to art, communication and sharing. Your creativity is especially fertile now. Secret vibration: creativity.
V: The V transit calls for seriousness and consistency. It's a period of methodical construction that may seem slow but lays lasting foundations for what follows. Secret vibration: solidity.
W: The W transit brings an energy of change and exploration. It's a period when life surprises you and pushes you out of your comfort zone. Welcome the unexpected with curiosity. Secret vibration: exploration.
X: The X transit places love and responsibilities at the heart of this long period. Matters of family, home and service to others are especially prominent. Secret vibration: service.
Y: The Y transit is a long period of spiritual deepening. You seek the meaning of your life with particular intensity. It's a period of great inner richness, even if it can seem mysterious from the outside. Secret vibration: mystery.
Z: The Z transit is a long period of power and transformation. It's often a period of great achievements but also major questioning. What ends prepares something greater. Secret vibration: transmutation.
